goal: Land a warm CPU-only Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 INT8 sidecar under asr/engine/. JSONL stdin/stdout. No TCP/UDP listener. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, ONNX Runtime CPUExecutionProvider, intra-op threads <= 4. Weights: fractal1 ~/aicam/parakeet-cpu INT8 (onnx-asr nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3). Do not vendor Papyrus morphist-asr. Do not install onnxruntime-gpu. Wrong shape -> error http 422. Protocol (pin, hono sibling uses this): stdin JSONL {id, op?: 'transcribe'|'health', wav_path?: string, pcm_f32?: number[], sample_rate?: 16000}; stdout JSONL {id, ok, text?, error?, http?, state?, provider?, model?}. health reports warm|cold|down, CPUExecutionProvider, model id. --once FILE.wav for CLI. Second transcribe must not reload weights. Cite: openspec/changes/add-parakeet-engine/specs/parakeet-asr/spec.md and add-parakeet-api CPU-only + sidecar-no-port requirements.

acceptance.command: test -f asr/engine/sidecar.py && python3 -m py_compile asr/engine/sidecar.py && grep -q CPUExecutionProvider asr/engine/sidecar.py && grep -q CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES asr/engine/sidecar.py
